spec.name: Trend v17
spec.notes: Classic trend signal on trailing returns. Weekly rebalance.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.9, annual return 7%, maximum drawdown 12%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy lacks sufficient documentation and empirical validation. With no exhibits provided to support the performance claims, the court cannot verify the robustness of the signal or the accuracy of the backtest. The research log indicates a very small sample size of trials, suggesting the strategy may be under-optimized or prone to overfitting. Given the lack of evidence, deploying real capital is imprudent. The agent is directed to conduct further testing and provide comprehensive performance data, including transaction cost analysis and risk metrics, before requesting capital again. Paper trading is authorized to establish a track record.
